detail.title: Marketing Manager
detail.description:
About the Opportunity

A fast-growing HR SaaS player operating in the Talent Management and HR Technology sector, focused on simplifying hiring, onboarding, and people operations for mid-market and enterprise customers. We build product-led solutions that drive measurable business outcomes through better recruitment and employee life-cycle management.

We are hiring an on-site Marketing Manager based in India to own demand generation, performance marketing, and brand growth initiatives that accelerate revenue and customer acquisition.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute integrated demand-generation campaigns across digital channels (search, social, email, and content) to deliver qualified pipeline.
  • Plan, run, and optimise paid media (Google Ads, Facebook/LinkedIn) and SEO programs to maximise CPL and CAC efficiency.
  • Create and manage content strategy—blogs, landing pages, case studies, and nurture tracks—to improve organic visibility and conversion rates.
  • Use Google Analytics, campaign tracking, and attribution modelling to report performance, identify growth levers, and drive continuous optimisation.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to align go-to-market priorities, lead handoff, and lifecycle campaigns that boost activation and retention.
  • Manage external agencies and vendors, control campaign budgets, and ensure on-time delivery with clear KPIs and ROI focus.

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Digital Marketing
  • SEO
  • Google Analytics
  • Content Marketing

Preferred

  • Google Ads
  • HubSpot

Location: India (On-site)

Benefits & Culture Highlights

  • High-ownership role in a product-led HR tech environment with visible impact on growth metrics.
  • Collaborative, metrics-driven culture with opportunities for professional development and cross-functional exposure.
  • Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and learning budget.

We’re looking for a results-oriented Marketing Manager who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across digital channels—ideal for marketers passionate about growth, analytics, and building brand momentum in the HR tech space.

detail.title: Business Development Executive
detail.description:
Scouto is building an autonomous AI recruiter that can source, outreach, screen, and schedule candidates without human intervention. Our goal is simple: make hiring instant, effortless, and AI-powered.

We are looking for a Sales / Business Development Executive to manage inbound interest, conduct initial conversations with prospective clients, and ensure timely engagement with companies actively exploring recruitment solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run cold sales calls using our in-house tools.

  • Engage with inbound and warm leads via phone calls, WhatsApp, and other direct communication channels

  • Conduct initial qualification conversations to understand hiring needs and timelines

  • Follow up systematically with existing and previously contacted leads

  • Schedule discovery or demo calls for senior team members when appropriate

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of lead interactions in shared systems or CRM tools

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine outreach messaging and improve response rates

Required Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication skills with a professional and confident phone presence

  • Ability to clearly articulate value propositions and ask structured discovery questions

  • High level of responsiveness and follow-through in lead communication

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment

  • Willingness to quickly learn and understand Scouto’s product and target customers

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in sales or similar client-facing roles

Familiarity with CRM tools, lead tracking systems, or sales workflows
